comment: Drone asset manifest. mesh.* carries the rig conventions proven by
headless GLB forensics and the dev viewer, as DATA: hosts must not
re-derive them. noseAxis = the glTF axis the mesh faces at heading 0;
yawTrimDeg = extra rotation.y (deg) a host applies so heading 0 = north.
mesh.url / controller.url are RELATIVE to the package baseUrl (package.json).

mesh.scaleNote: effective mm->m factor is hostScale * bakedScale = 0.001; the 0.01 fix is baked into node WM233_352, hosts must add ONLY 0.1
